# A transaction carrying both a cheque number and a description.
#
# The beancount export writes `* "payee" "narration"`, and the two come from
# different GnuCash fields — the number and the description. A transaction with
# only one of them takes a different branch, so this is the half that pins the
# pair as a pair: `* "CHK-1002" "Paid the printer"`.
#
# Uses the accounts from beancount_export_edge_shapes' own ledger.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_beancount_export_edge_shapes.py.
2024-03-01 * "CHK-1002" "Paid the printer"
	Assets:Bank -5.00 XCD
	Expenses:Sundry 5.00 XCD
